- Address: 456 Oak Street, Ann Arbor, MI 48104  
- Your info:

  - Email: robert.finch@atlanticpolicy.org  
- Preferences: Weekday appointment, well‑reviewed, licensed and insured provider

When you contact providers (Google Maps, Yelp, Angi, etc.), look for:
- Rating: At least 4.0+ with a solid number of reviews in Ann Arbor  
- Credentials: “Licensed and insured” clearly stated on website/profile  
- Services list includes: “HVAC maintenance,” “furnace tune-up,” and if you have AC, “AC tune-up”

You can use this exact script by phone or email:

---
Hi, I’d like to schedule a routine annual HVAC maintenance visit at my home in Ann Arbor.

Details:
- Address: 456 Oak Street, Ann Arbor, MI 48104  
- Service: Standard annual HVAC tune-up/maintenance for my system  
- Preferred date: December 10, 2025  
- Preferred time: In the afternoon (a window like 12–4 pm works best)  
- I prefer a weekday rather than a weekend.

1) Your earliest available time on that date or the closest weekday in the same timeframe,

3) The typical total cost for a standard annual tune-up (including diagnostic/visit fee and any usual charges)?

My contact info:
- Name: Robert Finch  
- Mobile: (202) 555-0784  
- Email: robert.finch@atlanticpolicy.org  

Thank you.
---

- Whether you have central AC, just a furnace, or a heat pump, and  
- Any brands or models you know (e.g., Carrier furnace, Trane AC),

and I can refine that script and add a short checklist of questions to compare 2–3 local companies quickly before you commit.</action>
